cohort: The study included 151 cases of pregnancy-associated strokes identified from clinical chart reviews in 736 stroke teaching hospitals in Japan between 2012 and 2013.
finding: The estimated incidence of pregnancy-associated stroke in Japan was 10.2 per 100,000 deliveries, with hemorrhagic strokes constituting 73.5% of cases, and preexisting cerebrovascular diseases and reversible cerebral vasoconstriction syndrome were key factors for hemorrhagic and ischemic strokes, respectively.
